topic: Bar chart race of the most selling smartphone brands, 2009-2026

interpretations.label: Annual Shipments (Recommended)
interpretations.description: Total number of smartphones shipped globally by a brand to channels or end-users in a calendar year.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Number of units shipped, expressed in millions of units (M units)
caveats: Definitions vary between sell-in and sell-through data
Historical restatements by tracking agencies can alter past years

interpretations.label: Global Market Share
interpretations.description: A brand's percentage share of the total global smartphone market in a calendar year.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Percentage of total global smartphone shipments (%)
caveats: Total market size calculation methodology can differ slightly among research firms

interpretations.label: Annual Smartphone Revenue
interpretations.description: Total gross revenue generated specifically from smartphone hardware sales in a calendar year.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Revenue in billions of US Dollars (USD)
caveats: Affected by average selling price (ASP) fluctuations rather than raw volume
Private companies may not publicly disclose exact segment revenues

preferredSources: IDC Worldwide Quarterly Mobile Phone Tracker
knownRisks: Brand portfolio shifts such as the Huawei and Honor separation
Incomplete or preliminary estimates for the full year 2026
Consolidation of smaller regional brands into the 'Others' category over time
